entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A guildless goblin mob boss on Ravnica who works as a mercenary, profits from wars and aims to join Ravnica's monied elites.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Krenko lives.

entities.name: Mr. Taz
entities.description: A well-connected patron who offers Krenko jobs with very high rewards.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that administers the maximum security facility Udzec.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose guildhall Sunhome Krenko infiltrates.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros Legion's guildhall.

entities.name: Vinrenn
entities.description: The contested guildmaster of the Boros Legion, whose chambers Krenko enters.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The angel leader of the Boros who later arrests Krenko hoping to charge him for his crimes during the Invasion.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose bank holds a safebox with Krenko's payment.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose experiment accidentally opens a portal near Krenko and Mr. Taz.

entities.name: Dargig
entities.description: The youngest of the Shattergang Brothers, killed by Krenko.

entities.name: Shattergang Brothers
entities.description: A goblin group including Dargig.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrests Krenko and is injured by his magic shiv.

entities.name: Sawtooth Prison
entities.description: A prison where Krenko incites a riot.

entities.name: Udzec
entities.description: A maximum security facility administered by the Azorius Senate.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who invaded Ravnica in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Nicol Bolas's invasion of Ravnica, during which Krenko and the goblins stole treasures.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Ravnica, which Krenko fought against while profiting from it.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Hosts a large party for all guilds and is murdered a few days after Zegana.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A victim murdered the night of Teysa Karlov's party.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: A scientist who Krenko tries to get information from and kidnaps; he is accidentally killed by a brainwashed citizen.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who thwarts Krenko's kidnapping and reveals the truth of the murders at Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Works with Proft and helps subdue the brainwashed man and defeat Oba.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The place where Proft reveals the truth of the murders.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The central dryad of Trostani, who organized the murders in retribution for those she considered traitors to the plane during the Invasion.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The dryad entity of which Oba is the central dryad.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps defeat Oba and free Krenko.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A glowing enchanted shiv given to Krenko by Mr. Taz, which could reportedly punch through force barriers.

events.summary: Krenko accepts a job from Mr. Taz to raid the Boros guildhall and is given a glowing shiv.
events.quote: Mr. Taz gave Krenko a tool specially made for that job.

events.summary: Krenko surveils Sunhome, pushes it into violence and uses the chaos to reach Vinrenn's chambers.
events.quote: He provided that push and used the ensuing chaos to cover his actions

events.summary: Krenko breaks the detention sphere holding an angel, plucks two feathers and falsely blames her escape before fleeing.
events.quote: He broke the sphere, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

events.summary: Mr. Taz offers Krenko another job at an Orzhov bank, and an Izzet portal opens nearby.
events.quote: an Izzet experiment unintentionally opened a portal nearby

events.summary: During a goblin gang war Krenko kills Dargig and is arrested by Gideon Jura, injuring him with the shiv.
events.quote: Krenko killed Dargig, the youngest of the Shattergang Brothers

events.summary: Krenko incites a riot at Sawtooth Prison, is transferred toward Udzec, and escapes to rejoin his gang.
events.quote: he was able to slip away to rendezvous with his gang

events.summary: During Bolas's invasion, Krenko and the goblins steal treasures from evacuated locations.
events.quote: Krenko and the other goblins stole treasures

events.summary: Krenko fights in defense of Ravnica during the Phyrexian invasion while profiting from looting behind Phyrexian lines.
events.quote: Krenko fought in defense of Ravnica during the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: With his enterprise rebuilt, Krenko sets his sights on joining Ravnica's monied elites and elevating his goblin gang.
events.quote: he has set his sights on his next goal: joining the ranks of Ravnica's monied elites

events.summary: Krenko sneaks into Teysa Karlov's party to network and is noticed by the host, to whom he owes a debt.
events.quote: Krenko acquired an invitation and snuck in to attempt networking

events.summary: Fearing he is next after the murders of Zegana and Teysa, Krenko kidnaps Kylox but is thwarted by Proft and Etrata; a brainwashed citizen attacks and accidentally kills Kylox.
Proft reveals that Oba organized the murders; Krenko is captured when Oba attacks but freed after Kaya and Etrata defeat her, then arrested by Aurelia.
events.quote: He was later arrested by Aurelia

relations.note: Works jobs for him as a mercenary.
relations.quote: Despite the obvious danger, Krenko likes working for Mr. Taz

relations.note: Killed during a goblin gang war.
Arrested him and was injured by his shiv.
relations.quote: When he was arrested by Gideon Jura

relations.note: Targeted him because he profited from the Invasion.
relations.quote: The mob boss was targeted because he profited from the Invasion.
Oba, the central dryad of Trostani

relations.note: She arrests him hoping to charge him for his crimes.
relations.quote: who hoped to find a way to charge him for his crimes during the Invasion
